Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: The September/October 0%-admission regression is historical. The recovered current code passes firstLevelLaws on JVM and JS (84 each at the final code candidate), and the local compact comparison cohort meets 22/24. Weak LWU 95% qualification still fails; hosted Linux 21/24 is not superseded by local macOS. Passing a reporting law is not scientific admission.

Fresh context: Yes: scientific and performance requalification.

Next action: Requalify the unchanged frozen Gaussian/LWU acceptance criteria on a bound current source/runtime, retaining all failed/unmet cells and hosted/local distinctions. Full C0 100000-voxel throughput, coverage and native/export evidence remain separate; no target relaxation.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; docs/plans/profile-hrf-condition-milestone.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Remediation accepted 2026-09-13: reopen condition qualification because shared decoder admission can use stale curvature and certificate enforcement is not integrated. Retain the dated historical results; do not erase or relabel the original measurements.

Prerequisites: corrected PHRF-09 decoder and PHRF-12 certified preparation, plus the existing PHRF-13/18/22 prerequisites. This milestone stays independent of trial implementation and B0.

Concrete requalification:
1. Rerun the frozen Gaussian and LWU C0 accuracy cohorts with exact source/provider revisions after the repairs. Compare terminal coordinates, signed amplitudes, direct-family energy, terminal curvature/SD and admission decisions against an independent sufficiently searched direct time-domain reference. Report all attempted voxels and refusal/budget/weak/prior/boundary categories; never assess accuracy only on an undisclosed selected subset.
2. Keep Gaussian SNR >=0.5 target admission >=95%, p95 latency <=0.02 s, FWHM <=0.05 s, relative amplitude L2 <=1e-3. Keep LWU SNR 0.5's historical 83% vs 95% shortfall visible; quantify changes from corrected terminal curvature and retain an explicit restricted qualification if the unchanged gate remains unmet. Do not lower SD thresholds or family accuracy to recover a pass. SNR 0.25 remains reported, not silently promoted into qualification.
3. Exercise prior/no-prior, weak/null/ambiguous inputs, zero/exhausted budgets, rejected/refused candidate recovery, and certified/mismatched geometry end to end. Ensure output summaries and query values describe the returned shape and carry uncertainty availability honestly.
4. Measure actual supported condition paths: compact/shared-AR and the supported retention path. C0 T=600,C=3,V=100000, complete JVM compute <=30 s on the frozen baseline and <=256 MiB engine live state; report preparation/certification, whitening, projection, pooling if used, decode, readout and IO separately and in totals. No extrapolated 100000-voxel pass; JS reports its own measurements. Any newly required terminal jet is counted and its budget disposition documented.
5. Update docs/plans/profile-hrf-condition-milestone.md and the runnable workflow example with exact cohort seeds, per-family budgets, revisions, raw receipts, current admitted domain and unresolved scientific boundaries. JVM+JS tests/laws pass; full statistical interval qualification remains PHRF-14.
6. Close only with a new dated evidence receipt and explicit disposition of every unmet target. The old 9.0-second receipt and green historical tests alone cannot re-close this ticket.

---
Prior implementation criteria retained for traceability (the dated scope clarification above governs where it differs):

Release milestone for ConditionMeans within the existing unified epic; does not require banded trial factors or finite-state completion.
Acceptance:
- Qualified Gaussian/LWU family domains, compact compiler/runtime, shared decoder/pooling/executor and signed condition/query outputs work end-to-end. Half-cosine is explicitly admitted or rejected by chart/cell.
- Independent direct time-domain reference verifies compact energy/readout, exact alpha=0 law, original-family approximation, rank/conditioning and bounded routing over the complete frozen C0 cohort. Apply the declared >=95% local admission and p95 peak/FWHM/amplitude budgets; null/ambiguous regimes retain statuses.
- Known-truth condition simulations assess shape/amplitude recovery, weak/prior-dominated cases, neural-timing confounding, spatial pooling and held-out predictions. Conditional uncertainty is labeled; claimed 95% intervals require >=500 independent replicates per regime plus binomial coverage uncertainty.
- Measure <=30 s C0 compute goal, <=256 MiB engine goal, projection/shape-stage overhead and V/rank/C/T scaling with PHRF-20. No trial-sized workspace or hidden runtime dictionary/stencil scan. Accuracy cannot be traded away to meet rank/time caps.
- Runnable typed example and real exported structural coefficient/query axes; fixed/nuisance recovery and deterministic chunk/worker output. Affected JVM+JS tests, laws and condition integration gates on exact provider pins; distinguish unrelated failures.
- This milestone is condition-only evidence. Trial calibration/performance remains open for PHRF-14/15/16 and the parent epic.
Performance: early complete-workload evidence, not microbenchmark extrapolation; every unmet target is explicit and requires recorded disposition before qualification.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 d0d3d44b533dd5d01022968a2dba20bb5807252026e1fb1ebdf4b69677148168). Work-item index: docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items.md. Shared unification probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_unification.py (SHA256 55ca9b653e911430d8d8268248e61dac1e8be2ec3ada507f71fd1d9a124d2e28); receipt: docs/plans/profile_hrf_unification_checks.json. Existing research probes remain docs/plans/profile_hrf_context_checks.py and tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py. Supplied condition/trial/innovation/alignment artifacts were inspected and rerun; exact source hashes and limitations are in the specification. These are planning/research artifacts, not production Scala implementation, broad calibration or throughput evidence.
